messages:
maria: Heads up — updating docs example for KV prefetch + custom batching policy. Found wrong param in SDK snippet.

kevin: Which file? PR?

maria: docs PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — I pushed a quick fix but tests failing on examples/kv_cache.md codeblock. The SDK sample uses `batch_policy=Batcher()` but our API requires `batching_policy={'max_tokens':1024}` now.

lina: :eyes: I can fix the snippet, but want to keep backward compat example. Maybe show both old and new.

kevin: Agree. Could we add a migration note and small code diff. Also update Console link.

maria: Added migration note in PR description. Need someone to update the code sample to use the JS and Python SDK variants. Here's the proposed Python snippet:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
client.generate("hello", batching_policy={'max_batch_size':8, 'max_tokens':512}, kv_prefetch=True)
```
Is that accurate?

sam: kv_prefetch param exists server-side but SDK exposes `kv_caching` boolean in v0.9.0 — we should use `kv_caching=True` in the snippet. Also `kv_prefetch` is an internal flag.

maria: Good catch. I'll update. Could someone run `docs smoke` to verify code blocks?

docs-bot: docs-bot: running docs smoke tests for PR #789 — 2 files to check.

lina: I pushed a fix to include both JS and Python blocks and a short migration line. Also fixed a dead link to /console/cache-settings.

kevin: Left a comment about adding a tiny benchmark note: 'expected latency tradeoff when enabling kv_caching with small batch sizes' — docs should warn about tail latency.

maria: Added benchmark snippet and linked to perf guide. Ready to merge after smoke passes. Thanks :tada:

docs-bot: docs-bot: smoke tests passed for PR #789 — all examples render.

sam: :shipit: merging now.

maria: Merged. I'll follow up to backport to v0.9 branch.

kevin: Nice. Can we also open a small issue to track deprecation of kv_prefetch flag so we don't lose it in examples?

lina: Created issue #1022 — will triage.

maria: Thanks everyone.
